why: The new branch calls splitter.plan while splitter starts as null, which reads as a TypeError. initCheckout creates the splitter whenever flags.splitPayments is on, and web/server.js calls initCheckout once with the same config before the server listens. web/config.js deep-freezes that config, so the flag cannot turn on later without a splitter. config/test.json sets the flag, so the branch is the tested path, not a dead one.
